rules.statement: Author exactly five materially different commercial shots for the supplied DN80 CL2500 pneumatic cascade control-valve model. The script must tell one causal product-recognition story rather than relabeling five similar camera states.

children.statement: Acceptance must show that the five shots advance one explicit causal arc, with a distinct question and viewer takeaway in every shot.
Acceptance must show materially different scale, camera axis, framing, visible action, transition device and rhythm across the five shots.

Every shot must define narrative purpose, viewer takeaway, start and end state, visible action, active components, framing, camera movement, lighting, layout, copy, incoming and outgoing transition, rhythm, comprehension hold and truth constraints.

rules.statement: Bind the script to the supplied STEP product tree and observed geometry. DN80, CL2500, pneumatic actuation, cascade plug, three named cages, seat, actuator and stem may be used as source labels; unsupported performance, certification, flow, failure-direction and maintenance claims remain prohibited.

children.statement: Acceptance must keep source facts, visual interpretation and prohibited claims distinguishable in the authored script.

rules.statement: This development phase stops after the creative route and five-shot script. Camera previs, Animatic, runtime manifests, WebGL, production assets, rendered evidence and public pages must not be changed or released in this phase.

children.statement: Acceptance must prove that only current governance, creative-route, five-shot-script and script-validation files changed relative to origin/main.
